Bind an ESM-2 model to compute

Source: R/06-adapter-esm2-model.R
esm2_model.Rd

esm2_model() returns a model ready for embedding on compute. With path = NULL, Transformers obtains the package-pinned Hugging Face checkpoint on first use. Set path to a runtime-visible, Transformers- compatible checkpoint directory whose architecture matches size to avoid that download.

Usage

esm2_model(size = "8m", compute, path = NULL)

Arguments

size

A canonical model name or upstream model alias.

compute

A bionemo_compute() descriptor.

path

Optional compatible, runtime-visible local checkpoint directory.

Value

An S7 Esm2Model bound to compute.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
compute <- bionemo_compute(
  recipe = esm2_recipe(),
  workspace = "~/bionemor-esm2"
)
compute <- bionemo_install(compute)
model <- esm2_model("8m", compute)
} # }
